description: Utility functions for handling emojis in Mattermost, including comparison, wrapping in React components, skin tone conversion, and matching.

methods.name: compareEmojis
methods.description: Compares two emojis based on search term and custom rules.

methods.name: wrapEmojis
methods.description: Wraps Unicode emojis in a span with class 'emoji' within a text string, returning React nodes.

methods.name: convertEmojiSkinTone
methods.description: Converts the skin tone of a SystemEmoji to a new specified skin tone.

methods.name: getSkin
methods.description: Returns the skin tone category of an emoji or 'default' if it has skin variations.

methods.name: unifiedToUnicode
methods.description: Converts a Unicode unified string to a Unicode character string.

methods.name: trimmedEmojiName
methods.description: Removes leading and trailing colons from an emoji name string.

methods.name: emojiMatchesSkin
methods.description: Checks if an emoji matches a specified skin tone.
